change_reason: Alpine mem-long enforces a 240 GiB minimum allocation; no chemistry, optimizer, prioritization, or acceptance decision changed.
objective: Obtain minimum and transfer-validation evidence needed for the first NAMD-capable TT-CPD parameter release without assuming one independent parameter fit per design stereoisomer.

first_wave.role: low-yield syn sentinel and held-out transfer case
anti family optimizer pilot and principal cis-anti product

second_wave.condition: cis-anti-I robust optimizer pilot completes or supplies a diagnostically stable restart path

sharing_release_requirements: identical stable atom-type and fitted-term scopes
all product-specific signed-volume stereochemistry audits pass
held-out relative conformer energies meet the registered acceptance policy
held-out gradients or Hessian-derived bonded responses meet the registered acceptance policy
explicit-solvent topology and NAMD smoke audits pass for every released identity

alpine_pilot_resources.active_compute_storage: Alpine SLURM_SCRATCH with periodic recovery copies

expansion_rule: Do not launch all-eight optimizations or Hessians merely because product identities exist. Expand a family only after its first-wave fit fails a named held-out quantitative criterion or a product-specific term is shown to be non-transferable.
interpretation: This policy authorizes evidence generation only. It does not create parameters, pass a force-field gate, or make any TT-CPD simulation-ready.
